stemMd: An object is raised between two fixed heights by different paths, with only gravity considered. How does the change in gravitational potential energy compare?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It depends only on the horizontal distance.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It is the same for both paths.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It depends on the colour of the object.

options.label: D
options.textMd: It is larger for the longer path necessarily.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It is zero for every path.

explanationMd: Near Earth, the change is mg times the height difference. It depends on endpoints, not path length. Other forces such as friction could add path-dependent energy losses, but are excluded here.

distractorRationale.a: Potential energy depends on height difference.
distractorRationale.c: Colour is irrelevant to gravitational potential.
distractorRationale.d: Gravity is conservative in this model.
